properties.name: Every enum-valued request field publishes its legal values in the tool schema, sourced from the compiled-in design schema at listing time — and a toolsnap guard fails when a hand-listed value set publishes no enum or drifts from it
properties.rationale: fact:defect-the-schema-discovery-tax-enum-fields-are-strings-so-the-published-schema-cannot-name-their-values named the cause: validation lived in the code path, not the type, so the schema a harness shows before the first call could not know the values (~24 refusals in one dev_storyflow session; Alex; qs). The fix the fact proposed was 'declare the enum in the TYPE'; this does it WITHOUT a second copy — the values are read from the one schema the validator enforces, so drift between published and enforced is impossible by construction for the 34 schema-sourced fields, and for the 4 code-only sets the enum reads the handler's own const. WHY A GUARD AND NOT JUST THE ANNOTATIONS: the annotations are a list maintained by hand (38 today), and the class of defect here is precisely 'a list maintained by hand with nothing checking it'; the guard keys on the doc comment's own hand-listed values, so a new enum field that forgets its annotation fails toolsnap, and a doc that lists a value the schema dropped fails too. It proved itself within the hour on the outcome mis-sourcing. NOT MEASURED: how many harnesses surface the JSON schema enum to the agent before a call — Claude Code does (its tool definitions carry `enum`); Alex's Grok TUI is unknown. WHAT IS NOT DONE: the sibling-inconsistency half of the same fact (naming a node, taking a status, relation shapes) — convention (i) is the next PR; the description hand-lists stay (the guard now checks them against the enum rather than replacing them), a later pass could trim them.
properties.subject: system
properties.summary: Ruling #3a, Anthony 2026-09-06. THE MECHANISM: reflow2_core::schema::enum_values(type, prop) reads a property's legal values from the compiled-in schema (node types, then edge types); reflow2_mcp::enum_schema provides one `schema_with` function per field (a macro per line) that calls it at tool-listing time and publishes {type: string|[string,null], enum: [...]}. The field stays a String for serde, so deserialization and the refusal path (which already names legal values) are unchanged — only what is PUBLISHED changes. The doc comment survives (verified: description retained beside the enum). 38 fields annotated: 34 from the schema (Capability/Requirement/Verification/Decision status, lineage, provenance, artifact_type, method, level, unit_type, env_type, flow_type, Constraint.category, Contributor.kind, the five Interface spec enums, change_type, epoch_type, quality_target; REALIZES completeness/conformance, CONSTRAINS.basis, DEPLOYED_TO.status, REQUIRES_RESOURCE.criticality, AUTHORED_BY.role, CHANGED.action) and 4 from the SAME const the handler enforces (review_relations' relation <- relate::REVIEW_RELATIONS; report_manual_work's diagnosis <- manual_work::DIAGNOSES; reconcile_verification's outcome <- a NEW verify::OBSERVED_OUTCOMES, which the handler's check now reads too; documents' doc_kind and propose_heal's strategy as consts in enum_schema). Two fields that READ like value sets are free strings in the schema by design (DesignRule.category, Component.level) — their docs were reworded as examples, not enumerated. THE GUARD: tools/toolsnap.py enum_invariants — a STRING property whose description hand-lists three or more backticked values separated by / or | must publish an enum containing every one of them; walks $defs (schemars hoists item structs there); one exemption on the record (export_graph.path lists the RESULT's values). Run against the committed pre-change snapshots it reported 41 fields — the failing-first observation. It then caught a mis-sourcing in this very change: outcome was wired to PRODUCES.outcome (pass/fail/partial/error) where the handler accepts passed/failed/skipped — fixed by the shared const. 36 toolsnaps changed. Three pins in an_enum_field_publishes_its_legal_values.rs. core 1580/0, mcp 361/0, skill_lint OK, fmt/clippy clean. No request SHAPE changed.
